question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 5.
solution:
The correct answer is Option (1)** "as well as". ** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Let's take a look at the phrase: ** to read and write letters and numbers (5) _______ to count.
 
• ** "As well as"** is a conjunction that is used to connect two ideas that are of equal importance.
 
• It is often used to add additional information to the first idea.
 
 
• **Example:** John enjoys playing basketball as well as football.
 
 
 
• The complete phrase will be: ***to read and write letters and numbers as well as__ to count***.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Option 2,** "but"**, is a conjunction that is used to contrast two ideas. 
 
• Option 3, **"for"**, is a conjunction that is used to give a reason or explanation. 
 
• Option 4,** "yet"**, is a conjunction that is used to show contrast or opposition.
